profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Raytheon
profile.summary:
Software engineer, team lead, and scrum master with most recent focus on Java microservice development in an Agile environment.  Several years of team leadership experience and direct customer interaction. 

Primary Skills: Java, Docker, Spring, Kubernetes, JUnit, Cucumber, JIRA, IntelliJ, Agile/Scrum
Additional experience with: Redis, Kafka, MongoDB, OWL/RDF, SPARQL, RDBs

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego,  Key West, Washington DC
positions.description:
• Interacted directly with government and internal customers to design and implement features
• Software customization and integration supporting sensor data analysis
• Spawned new contracts via creation and maintenance of toolkit and excellent customer interaction
• Extensive work with semantic graphs, data extraction and integration, and associated user interfaces
positions.insights: Skills: Software Systems · Code Review · Debugging · Development Design · Communication · Java

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project K   2008-2010
Principal Software Engineer and Project Ontologist
• Created a patented architecture for ontology-based systems
• Created the ontology to support Project K goals
• Extraction and annotation of unstructured text
 
Knowledge Management R&D    2004-2008
• Implemented new business initiatives in the knowledge management and geospatial software realms
• Team Lead for Distributed Knowledge Store IPT
• Primary contributor leading to significant follow-on investment
• Directed technology transfer efforts with other Raytheon teammates
 
DCGS 10.2 Program    2003-2004
• Implemented solutions using J2EE to provide worldwide communications to the customer
 
IDS-D Program    2001-2003
• Designed and implemented a new Java/Swing GUI framework
• Implemented many GUIs using the framework
• Guided and supervised other engineers in use of the framework
• Implemented client/server interface for Java applications
 
Sonja Program    2001
• Developed user interfaces using C++ and a Motif-derived language
• Updated designs in Rational Rose (UML)

SIVAM Program    1999-2001
• Object-oriented development (UML, Java, Swing) for this large-scale effort to assist policing and management of the Amazon rain forest
• Informal Lead role for four other engineers

CONCORD Program    1999
• C and Fortran implementations 

HYSAS Program    1995-1998
• Developed algorithms for evaluating and partitioning hydrographic sensor data (Ada/C) 
• Coded sophisticated user interface for rendering 3-dimensional graphical representations of sensor data
• Team Lead
• Developed material and conducted training sessions at user sites
• Significant contribution toward delivery on time and under budget
positions.insights: Skills: Software Systems · Code Review · Debugging · Development Design · Technical Leadership · Communication · Java
